_source: snapshots/2026-01.json..2026-11.json + Manatal matches API (updated_at >= 2026-01-01, stages 381877/381880/381881/381882/384349/1897035/388313/381903/342714 filtered client-side). 2026-11 role accounting counts 11 new win(s), excluding 10 carry-forward row(s) already won in an earlier month and 0 intra-month duplicate row(s).
_methodology: MONOTONIC FUNNEL (rank roll-up). Stage ranks: Initial Interview=1, Client Endorsement=2, Client Interview=3, Job Offer=4, Offer Accepted/Ongoing Contract=5, Started=6, Failed=0. Each match at rank K emits events for ranks 1..K dated by: r1 interview_at, r2 submitted_at, r3 interview_at, r4 offer_at, r5 offer_at (fallback hired_at), r6 updated_at. Each falls back to updated_at when null. For month M and rank R, a candidate is counted if they have any rank>=R event in M. YTD totals are unique candidates by max rank reached. EXCLUSIONS: (a) OA internal orgs 599280/1619851; (b) EVERGREEN org 1560151; (c) position_name contains 'POOLING'; (d) 10 EXCLUDE_HASHES per manatal/constants.py. Position type comes from Manatal custom_fields.justification (NEW LOGO / NEW REQUIREMENT -> New Logo, RAMP -> Ramp, BACKFILL -> Backfill).

_schema.ytdTotals: Unique candidates reaching each rank across the full period.
_schema.overallConversion: YTD conversion percentages computed from ytdTotals.
_schema.kpiSnapshot: KPI vs target keyed by metric, each {actual, target, status, note?}. Status: green = at/above target, yellow = within 10 points below, red = further below, gray = no target or no data.
_schema.positionTypes[]: New Logo / Ramp / Backfill roles filled, avg & median TTF, currently-open counts, and per-type candidate funnel conversions (intToEnd/endToClientPass/endToHire/intToHire/offerToStart). Position type comes from Manatal custom_fields.justification (NEW LOGO + NEW REQUIREMENT -> New Logo, RAMP -> Ramp, BACKFILL -> Backfill). A candidate active on jobs of multiple types is counted in each type. _funnel exposes the raw unique-candidate counts behind each conversion.
_schema.agingBuckets: Currently-open HEADCOUNT by days open (d0_30/d31_45/d46_60/d61_90/gt90), recomputed from the current month's aging.jobs, with each job's days-open recomputed from its opened date as of _generated (the snapshot freezes days at snapshot-build time), with each job's days-open recomputed from its opened date as of _generated (the snapshot freezes days at snapshot-build time), with each job's days-open recomputed from its opened date as of _generated (the snapshot freezes days at snapshot-build time), with each job's days-open recomputed from its opened date as of _generated (the snapshot freezes days at snapshot-build time).
_schema.oldestOpen[]: Top 10 oldest currently-open roles, oldest first by days open; days recomputed as of _generated; days recomputed as of _generated; days recomputed as of _generated; days recomputed as of _generated.
_schema.insights: Derived narrative: best/weakest month, TTF trend, longest-TTF position type, biggest bottleneck and recommended action.
_schema.dataGaps[]: Known holes in the underlying data.

_dataQuality.note: Loaded 1958 match records; applied filter dropping 337 OA-internal + 0 EVERGREEN + 0 POOLING + 40 EXCLUDE_HASHES = 377 total; kept 1581 candidate-job matches across 1529 unique candidates. NEW LOGO and NEW REQUIREMENT both bucket to 'New Logo' (Manatal dropdown value + legacy value). 17 candidates are Unclassified (their jobs' justification is neither NEW LOGO/NEW REQUIREMENT nor RAMP nor BACKFILL) and are excluded from per-type conversions but counted in overall YTD.

period.note: monthly[] covers Jan-Nov. Jan-Oct are closed; Nov 2026 is partial (25/30 days) and has a snapshot carrying 11 new win(s) plus 10 carry-forward row(s) excluded as already won earlier.

monthly.label: Nov 2026
monthly.carryForwardNote: 10 closed-won row(s) in snapshots/2026-11.json are carry-forwards of wins already counted in an earlier month (status won-pending-start). They are excluded from filled/rolesFilled/TTF here so the win is not double-counted; the snapshot is unchanged.

ytdRoles._note: Role counts cover Jan-Nov; every month now has a snapshot. Nov 2026 contributes 11 fill(s), after excluding 10 carry-forward row(s) already won in an earlier month so no win is double-counted. currentlyOpen is the 2026-11 roster re-aged to 2026-11-25.

ttfYtd.note: Across Jan-Nov 2026 snapshots; months with TTF data: 2026-01, 2026-02, 2026-03, 2026-04, 2026-05, 2026-06, 2026-07, 2026-08, 2026-09, 2026-10, 2026-11. Nov 2026 is partial and contributes 4 TTF point(s).

retention90d.note: Not tracked in Manatal . 90% specialist / 85% volume

aging.note: Roster is the 2026-11 snapshot's open roles (newest available), with days-open recomputed live as of 2026-11-25.

oldestOpen.role: CLINIC REFERRAL & PRIOR AUTHORIZATION (2 of 7 HC still open)

bestMonth.reason: 37 hires / 28 starts on 169 interviews (21.9% Interview->Hire) - the strongest month of the year.

weakestMonth.reason: only 11 hires on 178 interviews (6.2% Interview->Hire). Nov 2026 is excluded - it is only 25 of 30 days in.

insights.ttfTrend: Rising - avg TTF moved +8 days from 2026-05-2026-07 (30d) to 2026-08-2026-10 (38d)
insights.longestTtfPositionType: New Logo - 57.3d average time-to-fill (n=31), vs Backfill at 35.1d. New Logo roles take materially longer to close.
insights.carryOverRisk: 5 of 9 currently-open roles (7 of 12 headcount) have been open more than 30 days; 2 past 60 days.
insights.biggestBottleneck: Endorse -> Hire at 25.9% vs a 50% target - 24.1 points short, the widest gap of any tracked conversion.
insights.recommendedAction: Attack Endorse -> Hire first - it is 24.1 points below its 50% target and gates every downstream stage.

currentMonthPartial.label: Nov 2026
currentMonthPartial.note: Nov 2026 is in monthly[] but covers only 25 of 30 days (129 interviews / 22 hires / 11 starts so far) - do not read it as a month-over-month decline. It HAS a snapshot, and of its 21 closed-won row(s), 10 are carry-forwards of earlier-month wins, leaving 11 new fill(s).

dataGaps: 90-day retention is not tracked in Manatal - kpiSnapshot.retention90d.actual is null.
Regularization rate is not tracked in Manatal - kpiSnapshot.regularization.actual is null.

Manatal's Open API exposes only each match's CURRENT stage, so a candidate endorsed and then failed on a job collapses to rank 0 on that job; they still count if another of their matches holds rank >= 2.

CARRY-FORWARD: 10 of the 21 closed-won rows in snapshots/2026-11.json duplicate a (client, role, candidate) already present in an earlier month's closedWon. They were won earlier and are counted there, so this build excludes them from 2026-11 filled/rolesFilled/TTF; ytdRoles.filled would otherwise overstate by 10. The true new-win count for 2026-11 is 11. The snapshot itself was NOT modified.
INTRA-MONTH DUPLICATE CHECK CLEAN: no month's closedWon names the same candidate twice on the same (client, role). The intra-month dedupe remains armed for future runs.

SNAPSHOT INVARIANTS HOLD for 2026-11: startOfMonth=30 == somCarryOver headcount (30) across 11 role(s), and totalOpen == pipeline.open (12). monthly[].openingBacklog for 2026-11 propagates startOfMonth verbatim and is not suspect.

aging/oldestOpen/agingBuckets describe the 2026-11 snapshot's open roles with days-open recomputed live as of 2026-11-25, so they run ahead of the frozen snapshot values. Roles opened or closed after that snapshot was last written are NOT reflected. snapshots/2026-11.json itself was not modified.

Oct 2026 is a CLOSED month and participates in weakestMonth and the TTF trend. Its role counts come from snapshots/2026-10.json as last written; 19 of 22 closed-won roles carry a timeToFill (3 have no start date yet and are excluded from TTF).
Sep 2026 has TTF data for 11 of 13 closed-won roles; 2 role(s) have no start date yet and are excluded from TTF.
YTD totals are unique-candidate counts and deliberately do not equal the sum of the monthly columns.
Funnel counts are keyed on Manatal candidate id, so one person held under two candidate records counts twice. A known instance on MIRION (NUCMED) BILLING ANALYST inflates that role's funnel by 1.

Position type is derived from Manatal custom_fields.justification. NEW LOGO and NEW REQUIREMENT both map to 'New Logo'; RAMP->Ramp; BACKFILL->Backfill. 17 candidates whose jobs' justification is none of these are Unclassified and excluded from positionTypes[] conversions.
Loaded 1958 match records; after excluding OA-internal, EVERGREEN, POOLING and EXCLUDE_HASHES jobs, 1581 matches across 1529 unique candidates remain.

Stage filtering is done CLIENT-SIDE: this run paged every match with updated_at >= 2026-01-01 and kept the nine tracked stages itself, because Manatal's stage__in query param has returned wrong stages and spurious zeros.
